translations.web: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.
translations.bsb: Fools, in their rebellious ways, and through their iniquities, suffered affliction.
translations.kjv: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
translations.asv: Fools because of their transgression, And because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
